Smoking chocolate is a bad experience
Tonight, I decided to experiment and smoke cocoa powder. The powder used was Hershey's unsweetened cocoa powder.
To prepare, I rolled the cocoa powder in a joint, then smoked it.
The experience from smoking cocoa powder is not worth it, in my point of view. You have to smoke a lot of it to get the desired effect, and the effect that it has seems identical to that of a couple cups of caffinated coffee.
In other words, it feels like a basic caffiene buzz. The smoke leaves a bad taste in my mouth too.
Overall, the discomfort in my lungs from the smoke, was not worth it for the feeling. I am better off eating this stuff than smoking it.
